title: House, Rooms & Furniture: There is & There are
objective: Mampu mendeskripsikan ruangan dan perabotan di dalam rumah menggunakan struktur 'There is' dan 'There are'

theory.summary: Struktur 'There is' dan 'There are' digunakan untuk menyatakan keberadaan sesuatu di suatu tempat. Gunakan 'There is' untuk benda tunggal (singular) dan 'There are' untuk benda jamak (plural). Struktur ini sangat berguna saat mendeskripsikan ruangan dan perabotan di rumah.
rules: There is + singular noun (benda tunggal): There is a sofa in the living room. There is one bathroom upstairs.
There are + plural noun (benda jamak): There are three bedrooms in my house. There are some chairs in the kitchen.
Untuk membentuk pertanyaan, balik posisi: Is there a TV? / Are there any windows? Untuk negatif, tambahkan 'not': There isn't a garage. There aren't any plants.

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menggunakan 'There is' dengan kata benda jamak atau 'There are' dengan kata benda tunggal. Perhatikan dengan cermat apakah benda yang disebutkan satu atau lebih dari satu.
commonTrap.wrong: There is two bedrooms in my house.
commonTrap.correct: There are two bedrooms in my house.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
Sarah: "Welcome to my new house, Rina! Let me show you around."
Rina: "[...]"
options: There is two bedrooms in my house
Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
Thank you! Wow, this living room is beautiful! Is there a TV here?
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "Thank you! Wow, this living room is beautiful! Is there a TV here?" ("Terima kasih! Wow, ruang tamunya cantik! Apakah ada TV di sini?") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Rina.

dialogue.context: Rina mengunjungi rumah baru temannya, Sarah, dan mereka berjalan-jalan melihat setiap ruangan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Welcome to my new house, Rina! Let me show you around.
lines.translation: Selamat datang di rumah baruku, Rina! Biar aku tunjukkan sekeliling.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Thank you! Wow, this living room is beautiful! Is there a TV here?
lines.translation: Terima kasih! Wow, ruang tamunya cantik! Apakah ada TV di sini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, there is. There is a big TV on the wall. And there are two sofas.
lines.translation: Ya, ada. Ada TV besar di dinding. Dan ada dua sofa.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Very nice! How many bedrooms are there in your house?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Ada berapa kamar tidur di rumahmu?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: There are three bedrooms upstairs. Come, let me show you my bedroom.
lines.translation: Ada tiga kamar tidur di lantai atas. Ayo, biar kutunjukkan kamar tidurku.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Oh, I love it! There is a big wardrobe and a comfortable bed. Are there any plants?
lines.translation: Oh, aku suka! Ada lemari besar dan tempat tidur yang nyaman. Apakah ada tanaman?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, there are some plants on the table near the window.
lines.translation: Ya, ada beberapa tanaman di meja dekat jendela.

lines.speaker: Rina
lines.text: Perfect! Your house is really lovely, Sarah.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul meminta Anda mendeskripsikan rumah atau kamar Anda menggunakan 'There is' dan 'There are'. Dia akan bertanya tentang ruangan dan perabotan yang ada.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today, let's talk about your house. How many rooms are there in your house?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: There are five rooms in my house.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's nice! Tell me about your living room. What furniture is there?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: There is a big sofa and there are two chairs. There is also a TV on the wall.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! Now, describe your bedroom. Is there a wardrobe in your bedroom?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, there is. There is a wardrobe and a comfortable bed. There are some books on the table.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Last question: Are there any plants in your house?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, there are. There are three plants in the living room.

quiz.question: ___ a large fridge in the kitchen.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'There is' karena 'fridge' adalah kata benda tunggal (singular). 'There is' digunakan untuk menyatakan keberadaan satu benda.

quiz.question: How many bedrooms ___ in your house?
quiz.explanation: Untuk membentuk pertanyaan dengan 'There are', balik posisinya menjadi 'are there'. Kalimat ini menanyakan jumlah kamar tidur (jamak).

quiz.question: ___ three chairs around the table.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'There are' karena 'three chairs' adalah kata benda jamak (plural). 'There are' digunakan untuk lebih dari satu benda.

quiz.question: Is there a wardrobe in your bedroom? - Yes, ___.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban singkat untuk pertanyaan 'Is there...?' adalah 'Yes, there is' atau 'No, there isn't'. Karena pertanyaannya singular, jawabannya juga menggunakan 'there is'.

quiz.question: ___ any windows in the bathroom?
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah kalimat pertanyaan dengan kata benda jamak (windows), maka gunakan 'Are there' di awal kalimat. 'Any' biasanya digunakan dalam pertanyaan dan kalimat negatif.
